findings.title: Assign the Tailscale mock observer to its unit
findings.section: U5 — Desktop and provisioning lifecycle observers
findings.why_it_matters: A parallel implementer restricted to the declared U5 files cannot add the all-request observer that F21 requires. The current mock suppresses ordinary HTTP logging and persists only DELETE IDs in tests/tailscale-mock-api.py; assigning that support file to U5 closes the ownership gap without creating a second observer.
findings.suggested_fix: Add tests/tailscale-mock-api.py to the Files list of U5 (desktop and provisioning lifecycle observers), matching its already required request-observation work.
evidence: Add request observation to the existing VM fixture rather than duplicating the consumer elsewhere.
Existing Tailscale state produces zero requests of any method/path; fresh state retains authentication and deletion lifecycle proof.
